name: Entrance Test Allocation
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.candidate_name or doc.applicant }},

Greetings from the Admissions Office.

We are pleased to inform you that your application has been successfully processed for the upcoming Entrance Test. You are now eligible to select your preferred test center.

Application Details:

Application Number: {{ doc.applicant }}
Entrance Test: {{ doc.entrance_test_name or doc.entrance_test_list }}
Campus: {{ doc.campus }}
Entrance Test Date: {% if doc.allocation_date %} {{ frappe.utils.format_datetime(doc.allocation_date, "dd-MM-yyyy") }} {% else %} To be communicated {% endif %}
Entrance Test Time: {% if doc.allocation_date %} {{ frappe.utils.format_datetime(doc.allocation_date, "hh:mm a") }} {% else %} To be communicated {% endif %}
Program: {{ doc.program }}
{% if doc.assigned_preferences %}

Available Test Centers:

{% for p in doc.assigned_preferences %}
{{ p.center_name or p.provider }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}

Kindly note that test center allocation is based on availability and will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Once selected, changes are not permitted.

Please log in to the admission portal and complete your test center selection at the earliest.

Select Test Center

If you require assistance, please contact the Admissions Office.

We wish you success in your preparation.

Regards,
Admissions Team
subject: Entrance Test Center Selection – Action Required

name: Entrance Test Reschedule
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.candidate_name or doc.applicant }},

Greetings from the Admissions Office.

We are writing to inform you that your Entrance Test has been successfully rescheduled. You are now required to select your preferred test center for the new schedule.

Rescheduled Test Details:

Applicant ID:{{ doc.applicant }}
Test Name:{{ doc.re_entrance_test_name or doc.re_entrance_test_list or doc.entrance_test_list }}
New Test Date:{{ doc.re_allocation_date }}
Campus:{{ doc.campus }}
{% if doc.reschedule_reason %}

Reason for Rescheduling:

{{ doc.reschedule_reason }}

{% endif %}

Available Test Centers:

{% for p in doc.re_assigned_preferences %}
{{ p.center_name or p.provider }}
{% endfor %}

Kindly note that test center allocation is based on availability and will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Once a test center is selected, changes will not be permitted.

You are requested to log in to the admission portal and complete your test center selection at the earliest.

Select Test Center

Should you require any clarification or assistance, please feel free to contact the Admissions Office.

We wish you the very best for your upcoming entrance test.
subject: Entrance Test Rescheduled – Action Required

name: Entrance Test Result
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.candidate_name or doc.applicant }},

Greetings from the Admissions Office.

We would like to inform you that the results of your Entrance Test have been officially processed. Your performance details are provided below for your reference.

Applicant Details:

Applicant ID:{{ doc.applicant }}
Test Name:{{ doc.entrance_test_name or doc.entrance_test_list }}
Status:{{ doc.result_status or doc.entrance_test_status or "Processed" }}
{% if doc.entrance_test_status == "Absent" %}

Notice: Examination Absence

Our records indicate that you were marked as absent for this examination. As no performance data was recorded, a final score and rank have not been assigned.

{% else %}

Performance Summary:

Score Obtained:{{ doc.score_obtained or 0 }}
Maximum Score:{{ doc.total_score or 100 }}
Final Rank:{{ doc.entrance_test_rank or "—" }}
{% endif %}

You may access your detailed result, including section-wise performance and additional information, by logging into the admission portal using the link provided below.

View Result

Please note that further stages of the admission process, if applicable, will be communicated to you separately.

Should you require any clarification or assistance, please feel free to contact the Admissions Office.

We appreciate your participation and wish you the very best for the next stages of the admission process.
subject: Entrance Test Results – {{ doc.applicant }}

name: Interview Allocation
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.candidate_name or doc.applicant }},

Greetings from the Admissions Office.

We are pleased to inform you that your admission interview has been successfully scheduled. The details of your interview session are provided below.

Interview Details:

Date:{{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.interview_date) if doc.interview_date else 'To be communicated' }}
Time:{{ frappe.utils.get_time(doc.interview_time).strftime('%I:%M %p') if doc.interview_time else 'To be communicated' }}
Venue:{{ doc.interview_address or 'To be communicated' }}

Applicant Information:

Application ID:{{ doc.applicant }}
Program:{{ doc.program }} ({{ doc.academic_year }})
Campus:{{ doc.campus }}

You are requested to report to the venue at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled time. Please ensure that you carry all necessary documents for verification as per the admission guidelines.

To view your complete interview details and current status, please log in to the admission portal using the link below:

Interview Details

If you require any assistance or have queries regarding your interview schedule, please contact the Admissions Office.

We wish you the very best for your interview.
subject: Admission Interview Schedule Confirmation
